layouts.guidance: Record demonstrations that start from a region near the upper-left quadrant and force traversal through a mixed-corridor situation to avoid FIRE, illustrating safe corridor choice despite randomised fire placements.
layouts.what_it_teaches: Improves fire-avoidance generalisation across mixed corridor configurations by demonstrating safe progress through non-fire tiles while avoiding FIRE tiles in nearby cells.
layouts.rationale: Demonstrates avoiding FIRE tiles while navigating a mixed-corridor scenario, reinforcing fire-avoidance behavior across varied start/goal placements.
